payload.summary: Windows CI on PR #103 (MAR-2920): closing a written record descriptor can change the record ctime on Windows, so publication must re-verify accepted observations after the close.
payload.mistake: The simplified publication accepted the new record metadata and then closed the descriptor without re-inspecting it, so every later currentness check on Windows saw a changed generation and adds/init reported REPOSITORY_CHANGED after commit.
guidance: After acceptPublication and closeSync, call authority.acceptStagingCleanup() to re-verify observations that may differ only by ctime.
Simulate ctime-only changes portably by creating and removing an extra hard link to the record.
verification: Keep the ctime-after-accept regression test in test/records.test.ts; Windows platform jobs remain the authority for close-time metadata behaviour.

searchText: Windows ctime descriptor close publication acceptance re-verify observations hard link MAR-2920
